name: Qubicle File Parsing
definition: Converts a Qubicle .qb file into a list of VoxelDTOs by parsing binary data, handling uncompressed and compressed voxel slices, and applying axis orientation and color format transformations.
summary: Qubicle File Parsing reconstructs 3D voxel grids from binary .qb files by handling uncompressed and run-length encoded data with axis and color transformations.
